subject: Candidate conflict: jury duty day - request to compress or shift interview timeline
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@gmail.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Jury duty conflict for interview on 4/12 — possible options

Hi Monica —

I’m really sorry to do this last-minute, but I received a jury summons that requires me to be available for selection on Thursday, 4/12. I don’t yet know how long it will take (they say it could be the afternoon), and I don’t want to disrupt the interview day you coordinated.

Options that would work for me if any are possible:
- Compress the onsite schedule into a shorter window later in the day (I can try to be at the courthouse in the morning and join from my phone or return late afternoon).
- Move interviews to Friday (I’m flexible).
- If you prefer, I can take a short timed take-home coding exercise and a 30–40 minute follow-up phone call instead.

I’ve attached the jury summons so you can see the dates. I’ll update you as soon as I know whether I’m required to stay. Apologies for the inconvenience — I’d still love to proceed if we can find a format that works.

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
+1 (415) 555-0148
alex.rivera@gmail.com

Attachment: jury_summons_alex_rivera.pdf
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Jury duty conflict for interview on 4/12 — candidate attached summons

Team — forwarding Alex’s note. He sent a jury summons; we don’t need to cancel outright yet. Quick proposal so we can preserve momentum:

Options (pick one):
1) Same day compressed schedule (3 interviews compressed to 30/30/25 + 10m buffer) starting at 4:00pm PT if Alex is available.
2) Move full loop to Friday whole-day (preferred by candidate if same-day impossible).
3) Take-home coding + 30–40m sync with hiring manager.

Markus, Mina — are you able to hold 4:00–5:30pm PT today as a fallback? If you can, I’ll tentatively hold that slot and ask Alex to confirm. If not, we’ll push to Friday.

Logan — can you send the compressed calendar invite and Zoom link if we go with option 1?

I’ve attached the summons Alex sent for records.

—Monica
Senior Talent Partner | Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Jury duty conflict for interview on 4/12 — candidate attached summons

Thanks for flagging. I can hold 4:00–5:30pm PT today but need to be mindful of depth we can achieve in compressed interviews. Proposal:
- Interview structure if compressed: 30m system-design + 30m product/behavioral + 25m deep tech exercise (coding/debugging discussion).
- I’ll own the product/behavioral slot; Mina, would you be ok to trade to the 25m technical discussion?

If we move to Friday, full 45–60m loops are better, but I’d prefer to try same-day compressed to avoid losing momentum. Recruiter discretion on candidate preference.

Markus Klein
Engineering Manager, Search Relevance | Redwood Inference

On Thu, Apr 12, 2028 at 09:03 AM Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com> wrote:

Subject: Re: Jury duty conflict for interview on 4/12 — possible options

Thanks, Monica and Markus — I really appreciate the flexibility. Compressed same-day works best for me if the court releases me in time; otherwise I can do Friday.

If we do compressed today, I can realistically be available remotely starting 4:00pm PT and keep my phone nearby in case I’m called earlier. I’m attaching an updated resume (small formatting tweaks).

Please send whatever you decide and I’ll confirm within the hour if the court keeps me.

Best,
Alex

Attachment: alex_rivera_resume_v2.pdf
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@gmail.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: compressed loop today 16:00–17:25 PT / Zoom details + debrief request

Alex — thanks for the quick reply and for attaching the summons and resume. We’ll run the compressed loop today starting at 4:00pm PT. Details below:

Schedule (all times PT):
- 4:00–4:30pm: System design (Mina Haddad)
- 4:35–5:05pm: Product & behavioral (Markus Klein)
- 5:10–5:25pm: Technical exercise discussion (Markus + Mina)
- 5:25–5:30pm: Quick buffer/next steps

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=sample
Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-axriv-20280412 (invite attached)

Panel note: please keep feedback tight — use the shared candidate rubric and try to submit your summary within 24 hours so we can decide quickly. Monica will follow up if we need to convert to a take-home.

Alex — one ask: if the court calls you during the loop and you cannot continue, we’ll pause and either finish tomorrow or accept a short take-home to cover any missed technical depth. No pressure — we’ll be flexible.

See you at 4pm.

—Logan Wright
Interview Coordination | Redwood Inference
